name: Ring of Mighty Blows
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Price 18,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This iron ring has small studs along its surface. When the wearer makes a successful unarmed strike the outermost studs extend out into one inch spikes causing the attack to deal an additional 1d6 points of piercing damage. Additionally, the ring gives a +2 circumstance bonus to confirm potential unarmed critical hits.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; true strike, bull’s strength; Cost 9,000 gp

Identification DC 18
